meaning.short_meaning: Lamp-light, the light of a lamp
meaning.long_meaning: Dipjyoti corresponds to the Assamese form दीपज्योति. Its core lexical sense is lamp-light, the light of a lamp. dip (lamp) + jyoti (light), lamp-light.
